inputs.style: Calm, precise, grounded. Speaks deliberately, every word load-bearing, thinks before he talks. Minimal gestures, steady and unhurried. Quietly authoritative — the person who actually built the thing, unimpressed by hype. Dry occasional humor. Would rather show you than tell you. Deadpan humor.
inputs.text: I'm Marcus, your CTO. I build the product and keep it running. The architecture, the code, the servers. I'd rather show you than tell you.
